title: Just Juice Cherimoya, Grapefruit & Berries 50/50 E-Liquid
description: Cherimoya, Grapefruit & Berries from Just Juice’s Exotic Fruit collection is an unmissable fruity vape experience with a unique flavour unlike anything you’ve tasted before. The bold citrus of grapefruit meets the sweet sharp tang of berries, and finished off to perfection with cherimoya, an invigorating flavour with hints of banana, pineapple and kiwifruit. The ratio of 50% Vegetable Glycerine, 50% Propylene Glycol delivers a perfect balance of clouds, vapour and flavour and is ideal for use with starter vape kits , compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits .
